scope: Frames from one scripted real-browser recording of PlayIDE's ripple across diagrams (offline rule-based follow-on proposer, library-loan pack). Not a design mockup, human study, live-AI run or full IDE acceptance.

recording.browser: Playwright bundled Chromium via the chrome channel (not Google Chrome)

published_video.transformations: Raw webm re-encoded to H.264 CRF 22; no trims, cuts or fades

images.transformations: Single frame decoded from the raw webm (lossy video frame, not a browser screenshot)
